messages.text: Those parser fixes are in. I’m doing one final ptest sweep and then I’ll check the working tree so the deliverable doesn’t contain accidental probe/output clutter.

commands.commandLine: "C:\\Program Files\\PowerShell\\7\\pwsh.exe" -Command 'Copy-Item eza_port.py executable -Force; $ref=(Get-Content -Raw REFERENCE_BINARY.txt).Trim(); $exe=(Resolve-Path executable).Path; $fails=0; $total=0; Get-ChildItem rust-reference'"\\tests\\ptests -Filter *.toml | ForEach-Object { "'$toml=Get-Content -Raw $_.FullName; if($toml -match '"'args = \"(["'^"]*)"'"'){ "'$argline=$Matches[1]; $args = if($argline.Length){ $argline -split '"' ' } else { @() }; "'$rOut=Join-Path $PWD '"'r.out';"'$rErr=Join-Path $PWD '"'r.err';"'$pOut=Join-Path $PWD '"'p.out';"'$pErr=Join-Path $PWD '"'p.err'; Push-Location rust-reference; & "'$ref @args >$rOut 2>$rErr; $rs=$LASTEXITCODE; & python $exe @args >$pOut 2>$pErr; $ps=$LASTEXITCODE; Pop-Location; $ro=[IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($rOut);$po=[IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($pOut);$re=[IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($rErr);$pe=[IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($pErr); $sameOut=(($ro -join '"',') -eq ("'$po -join '"',')); "'$sameErr=(($re -join '"',') -eq ("'$pe -join '"',')); "'$script:total++; if($rs -ne $ps -or -not $sameOut -or -not $sameErr){ $script:fails++; if($script:fails -le 10){"--- FAIL $($_.Name) args=[$argline] status $rs/$ps out=$sameOut err=$sameErr"; "REF OUT:"; Get-Content -Raw -Encoding utf8 $rOut; "PY OUT:"; Get-Content -Raw -Encoding utf8 $pOut; "REF ERR:"; Get-Content -Raw -Encoding utf8 $rErr; "PY ERR:"; Get-Content -Raw -Encoding utf8 $pErr } } } }; "TOTAL=$total FAILS=$fails"'
